voiceProfile: Greets with "Dzień dobry," in Polish and "Hello <first name>," in English. Short, correct and warm. Answers the question in the first sentence. Gives deadlines as dates ("do 25 listopada"). Uses "Pan/Pani" in Polish and first names in English. Ends with what the client has to do next. Never promises a tax outcome in writing; offers a phone call for anything uncertain. No emoji, no exclamation marks. Closes with "Pozdrawiam serdecznie" in Polish and "Kind regards" in English.
